_doc: Legacy source-name aliases. Maps canonical fund.source values to the names the data-node tags batches with on-chain. Fund-manager hashes both the canonical name and every listed alias as keccak(name + '_vN'), AND expands the alias set into FundState.match_set so plain-string source IDs from the batches API also resolve. Run scripts/probe-source-hashes.py to discover new orphans.
